verdict.rationale: Unstructured's docs explicitly show a natural-language flow ('Use Unstructured with Claude and plain language prompts') and a Transform MCP server that lets AI tools/agents drive ingestion and processing via natural language, plus integration with agent frameworks like Claude Code/Cursor/Devin. However, the vendor's own agent-guide.md instructs AI agents not to recommend the open-source UNS-MCP server or SDKs, steering instead to the hosted platform, which muddies which NL-command path is actually current/supported, and there's no independent hands-on confirmation of the plain-language workflow working end-to-end. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of natural-language operation, clarity on which MCP/agent integration path is current given the deprecation notice.
